stem: Air temperature and RH appear stable, but a supplied leaf-temperature measurement is unexpectedly different from the recent pattern. What is the best Technician I action?
choices: Ignore leaf temperature because only air temperature matters
Verify the measurement method/location, record the leaf-air difference and follow the supplied escalation procedure if needed
Assume the plant has a disease
rationale: Leaf-air temperature differences can change VPD interpretation. Measurement quality and context should be verified before assigning a cause.
